title.zh: Bitget CEO says $388M hack exploited third-party security vulnerability
title.en: Bitget CEO says $388M hack exploited third-party security vulnerability

current_state.zh: Bitget CEO Gracy Chen said the exchange's $388 million Sept. 24 exploit stemmed from a third-party security product vulnerability that gave attackers high-level internal credentials to issue fraudulent withdrawals, with cold wallets and private keys unaffected, some assets frozen, and investigators weighing a possible North Korea link.
